phrases.latin: Conjūnctiō bona est, neque tam brevis ut ad alterum āëroplanum sērius veniāmus, neque nimis longa.
phrases.english: It’s a good connection, not so short that we reach the second plane too late, and not too long.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 216, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
